player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Billiard room and the Balcony, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I failed to recognize that I had already visited all the rooms and decided to stop the exploration. Next time, I will pay closer attention to the available directions in each room and try to visit all the rooms with the fewest number of room changes possible. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also keep track of the rooms I have visited to avoid revisiting them.
